sentences.text:
Biswajit Mondal vs Unknown on 27 February, 2026
54. 27.02.2026
Court
No.8 (Tanmoy)
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Ia No: CRAN/2/2020(Old No: Cran/134/2020)

In
 Cra/485/2019
 In Re: - An application under Section 389 of Cr.PC, 1973.

In the matter of - BISWAJIT MONDAL  ...applicant/appellant.
 Mr. Prabir Majumder  Ms. Sangeeta Chakraborty  ...for the applicant/appellant  Ms. Amita Gaur, Sr. Govt. Adv.
 Mr. Kunal Ganguly  ...for the State  Dictated by Arijit Banerjee, J.
1.
The applicant was convicted under Sections 498A/302 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and was sentenced to suffer imprisonment for life.
He says that he is in custody for 18 years now.
His appeal of 2019 has not yet been heard.
He prays for suspension of sentence.
2. Let the State file a custody report indicating the exact period of detention of the applicant, both pre-conviction and post-conviction.
The report shall also indicate the general conduct of the applicant in the Correctional Home as also whether or not he has criminal antecedents.
3. List this matter once again on March 6, 2026, before the Bench having determination preferably amongst the first five items.

(Apurba Sinha Ray, J.) (Arijit Banerjee, J.)
